name: Kidus Minyelshowa
tagline:
A designer working on brand visual
systems, and identity design.
bio: Hello! I am Kidus, a graphic designer and type designer. I enjoy solving visual problems with random thinking and careful craft. I stay curious and I like to experiment with new ideas, methods, and tools. My work combines design, typography, and technology to create useful and meaningful outcomes. I spend much of my time exploring innovation, learning new skills, and improving the way I work. I believe good design should be simple, purposeful, and built to last.
